definition: A volume ray-casting accelerator characterized by flexibility, using object order ray-casting.
summary: VIRIM Architecture is a hardware volume rendering engine that separates resampling and ray-casting into dedicated units, using programmable DSPs for shading to enable high-quality illumination models.
